Kirama Ara Sub basin as of 5.00 PM today. As Kirama wewa which is situated at upstream of Kirama
Ara is spilling towards Kirama Ara, it is warned that there is a possibility of occurring a flood situation
in some of lowline areas of Kirama Ara valley situated in, Mulatiyana and Kamburupitiya D/S
